candidates.topic: New Moon in Virgo — Reset Your Daily Life
candidates.teaser: A New Moon just landed in the most precise sign of the zodiac — and it's asking you to fix something you've been ignoring.
candidates.video_title: New Moon in Virgo Is Asking You to Fix One Thing
candidates.video_description: The New Moon in Virgo on September 10 opens a powerful reset window for habits, health, and daily routines. With the Sun also in Virgo, this lunation doubles down on precision and improvement. Set one concrete intention — not a vague wish.
candidates.script: The New Moon just hit Virgo — and this one doesn't care about your big dreams, it cares about your daily life. In astrology, Virgo new moons are considered the most precise reset of the year — the kind that targets systems, habits, and the small things you keep putting off. With the Sun also at 17 degrees Virgo, this lunation is doubled down. One broken routine. One neglected detail. That's what this moon is pointing at. What needs fixing in your life right now?

candidates.teaser: Mercury is sitting at the most urgent degree in all of astrology right now — and most people have no idea what that means.
candidates.video_title: Mercury at 29° Virgo — The Most Urgent Degree
candidates.video_description: Mercury is currently at 29 degrees Virgo — known in astrology as the anaretic degree, a point of urgency and culmination before a major sign shift. This is a moment to finalize decisions, finish conversations, and clear mental clutter before Mercury moves on.
candidates.script: Mercury is sitting at 29 degrees Virgo right now — and in astrology, 29 degrees is called the anaretic degree, the crisis point. It's the final push before a planet crosses into new territory, and astrologers read it as urgent, unstable, unfinished business energy. Mercury rules communication, decisions, and thinking — and in Virgo, it's at its sharpest. Whatever conversation you've been delaying, whatever decision is half-made — this degree is saying wrap it up now. The clock is ticking.

candidates.topic: Venus into Scorpio — Desire Gets Dark
candidates.teaser: Venus just stepped into Scorpio — and the way you want things is about to get a lot more intense.
candidates.video_title: Venus in Scorpio — Desire Just Got Darker
candidates.video_description: Venus has just entered Scorpio at 0 degrees, shifting the astrology of love, money, and attraction into its most intense and obsessive placement. In astrology, Venus in Scorpio is said to crave depth over surface, loyalty over charm, and all-or-nothing over compromise.
candidates.script: Venus just moved into Scorpio — and if you've felt a shift in what you want or who you want it from, that's probably why. In astrology, Venus in Scorpio is considered the most intense placement for desire — it doesn't do casual, it doesn't do surface level. It wants to merge, to know everything, to go all the way in or not at all. Venus is currently at zero degrees Scorpio, which means this energy is brand new and raw. Who or what are you suddenly obsessed with?

candidates.topic: The Astrological 2nd House — What You Actually Value
candidates.teaser: The house in your chart that rules money actually has nothing to do with how much you earn — it's about something deeper.
candidates.video_title: The 2nd House Isn't Just About Money
candidates.video_description: The 2nd house in astrology is often labeled the house of money, but its true meaning goes much deeper — it rules your core values, self-worth, and what you consider worth having in the first place. The sign on your 2nd house cusp reveals your instinctive relationship with security and desire.
candidates.script: Everyone thinks the 2nd house in your birth chart is about money — it's not, not really. In astrology, the 2nd house rules what you value, what makes you feel secure, and what you believe you actually deserve. Money is just one version of that. If you have Scorpio on your 2nd house, you might crave control over resources. Taurus there, you might need physical stability to feel safe. Your 2nd house doesn't show your bank account — it shows what you think you're worth. Those are very different things.

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Who Gave You Those Rules?
candidates.teaser: Saturn is retrograde right now — and it's asking you one question you probably don't want to answer.
candidates.video_title: Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Question Your Own Rules
candidates.video_description: Saturn is currently retrograde at 13 degrees Aries, a rare placement that pushes the planet of discipline and structure into the sign of raw independence. Astrologers interpret this as a period of questioning inherited authority — the rules you follow that you never actually chose.
candidates.script: Saturn is retrograde right now at 13 degrees Aries — and in astrology, Saturn retrograde is considered the time when the rules turn inward. You stop asking what the structure is out there and start asking which of these rules did I actually choose? Aries is the sign of individual will, the self that acts before it thinks — and Saturn sitting here in reverse is forcing a confrontation. The discipline you carry, the authority you obey — was that yours to begin with, or did someone hand it to you?
